name: Urban Water Infrastructure
description: Urban water cycle, urban water infrastructure components, stormwater drainage systems (SDS), water supply, sewage, and wastewater conveyance systems; SDS layout, SDC dimensioning – hydrologic design, intensity-duration-frequency (IDF) curves, design storm, risk-based and safe-fail design of SDS; risk, reliability, and vulnerability of SDS, functional and structural failures; design of water supply systems, network structures, pressure zones, head loss, and optimization of water distribution networks; sewage transport structures, gravity, and pressurized systems; combined and separate sewer systems, maintenance, and rehabilitation of sewer systems; hydraulic performance and structural strength, chemical resistance, and resilience characteristics of emerging materials-based water and sewer pipelines; decentralized stormwater wastewater management; sustainable urban drainage systems (SUDS), blue-green infrastructure, climate resilience in urban water systems; supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems.
